messages.text: BL-1797 🎵 in progress — test_ollama_ancillary_launch_gate.sh is red on main because its PATH-prepended ollama stub loses to the host's real binary: zsh -c sources ~/.zshenv, which puts ~/.local/bin (a real ollama since 2026-09-28 19:26) first, so scenario 01 starts the real server, which fails to bind 11434 and never answers ('never answered within 5s'), and scenario 02's stub-never-ran check passes vacuously; the test names its stub through SWARMFORGE_OLLAMA_BINARY, and an acceptance scenario proves a decoy zshenv cannot swap it
